notes: Strong start (6 points by T4 via Tomorrow's Headline steal and Tread Lightly + Docklands Pass HQ double steal), then from T6 to T16 the Runner clicked for credits every turn, ending at 40+ credits with 5 unplayed cards. It never contested the Server 4 remote where Freedom of Information (T12), Stoke the Embers (T14) and Tomorrow's Headline (T16) were advanced over several turns behind just Ping, or the Server 6 Post-Truth Dividend that won. One run at 6 points would have won the game.

Clean plan: scored Project Yagi-Uda three times (T2, T7, T9) and Fujii Asset Retrieval (T13) out of a single iced remote. R&D was left open on T1-T2 (Hybrid Release stolen), and the Corp clicked for credits on T4 and T11 when it could have been installing and advancing, but the Runner never pressured it.

Won on T5 with aggressive single-access R&D runs, and the T1 run into Server 1 that lost Buzzsaw to Ballista still stole Transport Monopoly. However, the Runner repeatedly ran R&D 3-4 times a turn (T1-T4) when the top card had not changed after a non-agenda access, wasting about 8 clicks re-seeing the same card. It also sat on 1 credit all game without building economy.

Ansel 1.0 on HQ locked out a HQ-flooded hand (Architect Deployment Test, Méliès, Megaprix, Superconducting Hub) for many turns, and the late scoring of Ingatan, ADT and Méliès won. But the Corp spent T5-T13 at 0-4 credits clicking for credits and re-rezzing Nico Campaigns the Runner kept trashing. On T14, with 14 credits, it installed and advanced Megaprix Qualifier in Server 11 without rezzing the ice, and the Runner stole it.

Won through R&D pressure (Witch Hunt, Stoke the Embers, Witch Hunt, Freedom of Information), with good use of Carmen and Tremolo. Mistakes: it never cleared the 2 Oppo Research tags, facechecked R&D with 2 credits on T5 (Loot Box), and made a Concerto run on T6 without paying Loot Box's 2. On T10 it made a second HQ run it could not afford through Doomscroll, re-seeing Gaslight and taking 3 net damage (Sure Gamble, Poison Vial, Underdome Irregulars), then facechecked the 3-ice Server 1 with 3 credits on T11.

The Corp spent T1 credits rezzing Otto Campaign (trashed by Pinhole Threading that turn) instead of keeping money for HQ ice. That left the HQ ice unrezzed for the whole game, so ADT, Megaprix and Méliès were stolen from HQ by T2. It stacked three ice on Server 2 (T2-T4) while HQ stayed open, ran at 0-4 credits for most of the game, and lost when Méliès was stolen from R&D on T13 behind only Vertigo.

Won, but ran R&D through Vasilisa unbroken almost every turn and collected tags, so Telework Contract (T5), Daily Casts (T6) and Beatriz Friere Gonzalez (T10, T13) were trashed and Backroom Machinations was enabled. It installed resources while tagged (Daily Casts T5, Beatriz T9) and never used Self-modifying Code or Unity to answer Vasilisa. Many clicks went to tag removal, though the T14 Server 1 dive for Artificial Cryptocrash and the final HQ steal were good.

Wasted repeated R&D runs on T1-T2 that could only re-see the same card, then clicked for credits nearly every turn from T3 to T16, reaching 40 credits with 5 cards never played. It facechecked Akhet (T11) and Afshar (T14) without breakers and never contested the remotes where Transport Monopoly (T6), Above the Law (T12), Divested Trust (T15) and Transport Monopoly (T17) were scored. It sat out T12-T16 entirely while the Corp built to 7.

Good early Urtica Cipher traps (4 and 2 net damage) and steady credits, but central defence was thin: Regenesis and See How They Run were stolen from R&D through Anemone alone, and Lotus Haze and Sisyphus Protocol were taken from HQ behind just Semak-samun. Biggest error: on T13 Mitosis put 2 counters on Hybrid Release (scoring requirement 2, as the T15 score shows), and the Corp advanced it again without scoring, so the Runner stole it from a naked remote. Clicks advancing the unrun Urtica in Server 2 were also low value.

Solid Jinteki game: two early Hedge Funds and fast scores of Hybrid Release (T5) and Lotus Haze (T12, T14) while the Runner was passive. Bladderwort, Bathynomus and Anemone kept up damage, and a heavily advanced Urtica Cipher in Server 1 delivered the flatline on T15. There were minor idle credit clicks on T7 and T9 with 9-12 credits, and the Corp let its credits run low near the end.

Won against a passive Runner, but slowly: from T3 to T8 it clicked for credits with 9-15 credits instead of building a scoring remote, and its first agenda was only scored on T6. On T14 it played Oppo Research and doubled it, spending everything (0 credits, 0 cards) with no way to punish the 4 tags. Embedded Reporting in a 4-ice remote was stolen on T13 by Mayfly, but later scores of Embedded Reporting and Tomorrow's Headline in Server 2 were sound.

Competent: it built economy (Fencer Fueno, Paladin Poemu, Trickster Taka, Mystic Maemi), stole Transport Monopoly early with Buzzsaw, and used Gachapon into Banner to get through two Akhets for SDS Drone Deployment (trashing Leech) and the winning Above the Law. It facechecked Envelopment (T6) and Akhet (T7) without a fracter, overdrew on T9, and let Above the Law be scored twice from Server 1 while assembling breakers.

From T2 to T9 the Corp mostly clicked for credits and drew, discarding from a full hand at the end of six turns while sitting on 10-14 credits, instead of adding ice. R&D stayed behind a single Paywall, and the Runner stole Post-Truth Dividend (T7) and Next Big Thing (T8) through it. Two Public Trails (T7, T10) gave tags with no follow-up, Embedded Reporting was stolen through 3 ice on T10, and Tomorrow's Headline was left in HQ behind one Funhouse for the final steal.

Wasted repeated R&D runs on T3-T4 that re-saw the same card, then from T13 sat on 20-48 credits with a full grip, mostly clicking for credits. On T20 (28 credits) it ignored the freshly installed Project Yagi-Uda in Server 3, which was scored on T21. On T27 (40 credits) it did not run the unadvanced card in Server 3, and Longevity Serum was scored from it next turn for the win; the steals of Longevity Serum, Yagi-Uda and Regenesis show it could break that server.

Revolver spent its counters on Saisentan on T1-T2. On T8 the Runner then played Carpe Diem into the known rezzed Saisentan (with Event as the named type) with only 4 cards in grip and no sentry breaker, and was flatlined, a foreseeable death. Earlier it gave up the remote, letting Longevity Serum be scored twice behind Tatu-Bola, and it installed a second Red Team on T8 while the first still had credits.

The HQ ice was never rezzed, so Project Ingatan was stolen on T1. Drafter's install subroutine was repeatedly used to overwrite rezzed Otto Campaigns in Server 1 and Server 2 (T2, T4, T7), throwing away the 2-credit rezzes. Megaprix Qualifier ended up in an unprotected Server 1 and was stolen on T5. The economy sat at 1-2 credits from T3 to T5, and R&D relied on a lone Drafter that let Superconducting Hub, Megaprix and the winning Méliès through.

On T1 it facechecked HQ with 1 credit and lost Buzzsaw to Ballista, then declined to steal SDS Drone Deployment even though it could have trashed Gachapon (which it trashed moments later anyway). From T3 to T6 it ran Archives repeatedly for Leech counters with 9-14 credits instead of finding a fracter, and facechecked Akhet on T7 with Raindrops. Mid-game HQ steals (Transport Monopoly, SDS) were good, but it never contested Server 1 while SDS and Transport Monopoly were advanced there for the win.

Strong opening credits (two Hedge Funds), but HQ held Hybrid Release and Sericulture Expansion behind only Karunā, and both were stolen. Rezzing Ivik (7) on T3 dropped the Corp to 2 credits, and after scoring Yagi-Uda on T6 at 0 credits its newly installed R&D ice stayed unrezzed, so the Runner took Hybrid Release and Yagi-Uda from R&D. On T7 it put Sericulture Expansion in Server 1 behind only the already-rezzed Ivik that Rising Tide could break, and lost.

Good fast Project Ingatan score behind Hagen (T3) and a second Ingatan on T8, then a smart Méliès score on T17 behind Ansel 1.0, whose no-steal subroutine blanked the Runner. However, the Corp ran at 0-5 credits from T3 to T12, kept re-installing Nico and Otto Campaigns into unprotected remotes for the Runner to trash, and R&D behind Vertigo leaked Megaprix and Architect Deployment Test.

Contested the Server 2 scoring remote well with Gauss (Oracle Thinktank, Artificial Cryptocrash, Remastered Edition, Oracle again) and won by checking the naked Server 8 on T17. But it never played anything beyond Gauss and Daily Casts, holding 5 cards and clicking for credits through T2-T4 and T9-T15. On T8 it ran Server 2 with exactly 5 credits, forgetting Paywall's 1-credit loss, so it bounced and Kingmaking was scored next turn; it also facechecked Capacitor on R&D on T5.
